snippet.title: Duil Release Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1462030/Duil/

Duil is a dark fantasy action RPG set in a fractured world called Targat. You play as Duil — a lost soul caught between dimensions, haunted by choices, sins, and the fragile hope of salvation.

As you explore twisted realities, you’ll be forced to choose: show mercy and earn virtue, or punish the wicked and claim rewards. Your path is shaped by your moral decisions — each of them influencing the world, your story, and ultimately, your fate.

Will Duil find a way out… or remain forever lost in the shadow of Targat?
